    pos = 0
    n = int(data[pos]); pos += 1
    par = [0, 0]
    par.extend(int(x) for x in data[pos:pos + n - 1])
    pos += n - 1
    q = int(data[pos]); pos += 1

    size = [1] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(n, 1, -1):
        size[par[i]] += size[i]

    ch = [[] for _ in range(n + 1)]
    for i in range(2, n + 1):
        ch[par[i]].append(i)

    tin = [0] * (n + 1)
    tout = [0] * (n + 1)
    for v in range(1, n + 1):
        base = tin[v] + 1
        for c in ch[v]:
            tin[c] = base
            base += size[c]
        tout[v] = tin[v] + size[v]
    del ch

    LOG = 1
    while (1 << LOG) < n:
        LOG += 1
    up = [par]
    for _ in range(1, LOG):
        prv = up[-1]
        up.append([prv[x] for x in prv])

    S = 1
    while S < n:
        S <<= 1
    tr = [0] * (2 * S)

    zl = [0]
    out = []
    t1 = b'1'
    for _ in range(q):
        if data[pos] == t1:
            v = int(data[pos + 1]); k = int(data[pos + 2]); pos += 3
            i = tin[v] + S
            j = 0
            while i:
                if tr[i] > j:
                    j = tr[i]
                i >>= 1
            if j:
                v = zl[j]
                k -= 1
                if k == 0:
                    out.append(v)
                    continue
            b = 0
            while k:
                if k & 1:
                    v = up[b][v]
                k >>= 1
                b += 1
            out.append(v)
        else:
            v = int(data[pos + 1]); pos += 2
            i = tin[v] + S
            j = 0
            while i:
                if tr[i] > j:
                    j = tr[i]
                i >>= 1
            if j == 0:
                nid = len(zl)
                zl.append(v)
                l = tin[v] + 1 + S
                r = tout[v] + S
                while l < r:
                    if l & 1:
                        tr[l] = nid
                        l += 1
                    if r & 1:
                        r -= 1
                        tr[r] = nid
                    l >>= 1
                    r >>= 1
    sys.stdout.write('\n'.join(map(str, out)))
    if out:
        sys.stdout.write('\n')

main()
